info.desc: Drunk is the third studio album by American musician Thundercat. It was released on February 24, 2017 by Brainfeeder. It features guest appearances from Kenny Loggins, Michael McDonald, Kendrick Lamar, Wiz Khalifa, Mac Miller, and Pharrell. It is his first studio album in nearly four years, his last studio album being Apocalypse. Drunk received positive reviews from music critics. A ChopNotSlop remix from OG Ron C, DJ Candlestick, & The Chopstars entitled 'Drank' was released as a special edition purple vinyl record. .

podcast.body: This wonderful album showcases influences from classic jazz, soul, and Southern funk, demonstrating that this type of music continues to evolve rather than remaining stuck in the past. It incorporates influences from experimental electronic music, experimental jazz, and various funk movements. "este disco que ha sacado es maravilloso ya no estamos acostumbrados a tener discos con influencias del jazz y del soul y del fan más clásico más su reño te hacen dar cuenta que aunque realmente no esté hoy tan de moda o tan en tendencia este tipo de música esa música sigue evolucionando no se ha quedado entrar en el pasado que sigue incorporando influencias de la electrónica del jazz más experimental e incluso de muchos movimientos fankeys."
